Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back. We are back for the chase, Sophia Dunkley and Danni Wyatt are the openers.
... CHASE BEGINS ...

Right then, England Women need 133 runs to win and go 1-0 up in the three-match series. India Women do have a capable enough bowling attack and given the playing conditions, this one could go right down to the wire, a lot will depend on early wickets though. Do join us in a bit for an exciting chase.

England Women will be quite pleased with that bowling effort. Their pacers didn't have the best of starts but once Bryony Smith got rid of Smriti Mandhana, their spinners did well to regain control in the middle overs. It was the spell of Sarah Glenn that proved to be the main difference as she picked up four wickets and didn't let the Indian middle-order settle down. The others too bowled well around her and they will now hope that their batters can go out and chase down the target.

India Women began positively with the bat as Smriti Mandhana hit a flurry of boundaries early on. Once she got out though, the scoring rate decreased. Shafali Verma tried to take on the bowling but was unsuccessful and the wickets kept tumbling. Harmanpreet Kaur and Richa Ghosh both got off to a decent start as well but neither could go on and play a big knock. In the end, it required a big effort from Deepti Sharma to take the Indian total above 130 runs and she has given the bowlers something to defend.

A well-contested first innings and Deepti Sharma is able to inject a bit of momentum into the Indian innings but it will be England Women who will be the happier of the two sides going into the interval. On a chilly evening, their bowlers have done well to restrict India Women to a just under-par score of 132 runs.

FOUR! Deepti Sharma finishes the innings with a boundary. She gives the charge to a full ball around leg and heaves it towards wide long on for a boundary. India Women get a 12-run over and finish with 132 for 7 on the board.
Goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Loopy and on middle, hit across the line to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! A much-needed one! A length ball around middle, Sharma gets across the stumps and paddles it past the diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Fullish and on middle, Rana comes out of the crease and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Quicker one, around middle, Sharma steps back to slog but only drags it off the inner half to the leg side. They cross as Sophie Ecclestone attacks the ball. She turns and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Slower ball again, full and around off, Sharma steps back and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Sneh Rana walks in next.

OUT! Pooja Vastrakar is run out! A full toss on middle, Deepti walks forward and heaves it over mid-wicket for a run. Again the fielder fumbles and they try to steal the second run. The throw comes to the bowler who collects and breaks the stumps behind. They appeal and the third umpire gets involved. The replays find Pooja Vastrakar has not grounded her bat. Should have put in a dive at least. India Women lose another wicket.
Short and on off, Sharma pulls it to deep mid-wicket and a slight fumble from the fielder in the deep allows the second run.
Angles it in, around middle, it's pushed down to mid on for a single.

FOUR BYES! That's gone through everyone. A length ball around off, slower one, Pooja tries to defend but misses. It goes over the stumps, beats the keeper and races behind. The fielder from short fine leg chases but fails to keep it inside.
Slower in pace, fuller and on off, Sharam whips it through square leg for a run.
Freya Davies (3-0-18-1) is back on to bowl the penultimate over.
Quicker and straighter, Deepti Sharma helps it to deep mid-wicket for another run in the over.
Tossed up around off, it's stroked through covers for one.
Loopy and around middle, Deepti clips it through mid-wicket for just a single.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.

Dropped! Skidding in from around off, Pooja Vastrakar tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It lobs behind, Amy Jones gets her hand to it but ends up pushing it further away and then there is no chance to grab it on the second attempt.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Sophie Ecclestone (2-1-13-0) is back on.
Tossed up around off, it's defended back. Sarah Glenn ends her spell - 4-0-23-4 - her career best in T20Is.
Pooja Vastrakar is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! It's a 4-wicket haul for Sarah Glenn, her best T20I attempt with the ball. Loopy and full, landing outside off, Kiran Navgire goes down to slog it across the line but fails to get enough timing. It's a simple catch for Danni Wyatt at deep mid-wicket and India Women continue to struggle.
Commentary.Howout: c Danni Wyatt b Sarah Glenn

Commentary.Commentary: Misfield! Short and down the leg side, Deepti pulls it towards short fine leg where the fielder misfields and they cross.

Another shout for an lbw! The finger stays down. Amy Jones has a word with her bowler and takes the DRS. Flighted delivery, full and around off, skidding in, Deepti Sharma goes down to sweep once more but there is no connection. She is pinged on the front pad, they appeal but the umpire disagrees. No bat, confirms the UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that the impact is outside off.
Huge appeal for an lbw! Full and around off, Deepti goes down and across to sweep but misses. The impact maybe an issue.
Loopy and around off, short in length, it's punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Short and outside off, forced to sweeper cover for one. Tidy from England Women.
A juicy full toss around leg, Kiran fails to sweep and it goes off her pads to short fine leg. Sharma wants a run but is sent back.
Beaten again! A length ball around off, angling away and leaving the batter, Kiran Navgire tries to drive but misses again. Amy is quick to take the bails off but nothing doing.
Swing and a miss! That missed the off stump by a whisker. Short and on off, angling away, Kiran rocks back to pull but misses.
Slower and fuller, around leg, it's worked wide of short fine leg for a run.
Angling in from a length around off, Sharma pushes it back to the bowler.
The last 5 overs are left. How many more can India Women get? Freya Kemp is back on.
Pitched up around middle stump, Kiran Navgire backs away but can't get it through extra cover.
Keeps it full and around off, this is stylishly flicked away by Deepti Sharma through mid-wicket for just another single.
Full and on off, Navgire drives it on the up towards long on and collects a single. The 100 is now up for India Women.
Pitched up, around off, this is stroked away through the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! On a good length from Bell, around off. Deepti Sharma stays back and waits for it before opening the face of the bat and guiding it past short third man for a boundary.

Lauren Bell comes back into the attack and starts off with a shortish delivery over middle. Kiran Navgire looks to pull off the back foot but mistimes it badly and aerially towards the vacant mid on region. She picks up a single.
Tossed up on the pads, this is flicked away towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Lauren Bell is back on to deliver her third over. 0 for 17 so far.
Loopy delivery, very full and dipping on the batter. Deepti Sharma works it in between mid-wicket and mid on for only another single.
Flatter delivery, around off, Sharma looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Switches to over the wicket now for the right-hander and serves a full ball on leg. Kiran Navgire backs away and works it in front of mid-wicket for a run.
Nicely tossed up, on middle and leg, this is turned through wide mid on for a single.
Smith comes from around the wicket and floats it up full and on off stump. Deepti Sharma eases it towards short extra cover.
Bryony Smith is brought back into the attack. 1 for 6 in her 1 over, so far.
Around the pads, Deepti Sharma works it away through mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Deepti Sharma is in next.

OUT! TIMBER! Straight through and Harmanpreet Kaur cannot believe it! This is quicker and flatter from Sarah Glenn, on off, Kaur steps down the track and looks to go downtown but this time the ball stays really low. The ball skids on as well as Kaur swings her bat at it. The ball hits the off stump and Glenn has her third wicket, superb from her. India are in a spot of bother once again.
On the shorter side and around off, Kiran Navgire waits for it and taps it towards sweeper cover for a run. Navgire is off the mark in international cricket.
On middle and leg, Kaur shimmies down the track and pushes it down to long on for a single.
This is pushed through quicker and fuller, around off. Kaur looks to cut off the back foot but the ball stays a touch low, sneaking underneath the willow.
Going down the leg side, Harmanpreet Kaur tickles it away down to fine leg and picks up a couple of runs.
Sarah Glenn (2-0-16-2) is back into the attack.
Full and on off stump, Kiran Navgire pushes it out towards extra cover. End of a successful over for Davies.
Fullish length, onto the pads, Kaur works it away through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Debutant Kiran Navgire walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just when Richa Ghosh started to look good, she has thrown it away. Freya Davies goes for the back-of-the-hand slower delivery, full and outside off. Ghosh gets low and looks to go after it. She ends up dragging the ball aerially towards wide long on. Bryony Smith moves to her right from long on and takes the catch. Davies gets the breakthrough for England and India lose their fourth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Bryony Smith b Freya Davies

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Pitches it up, in that channel around off, Richa Ghosh looks to get onto the front foot but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Length ball, angling down leg, Kaur gets low and paddles it down to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Skilful from Harmanpreet Kaur! Fuller and around middle, Kaur gets inside the line of the ball and uses the pace to scoop it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Freya Davies is back on. Her two overs have gone for 12 runs.

SIX! Wow, what a sweet sound that made off the bat! Around middle, Richa Ghosh gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 13 from the over and India Women are gaining the momentum.
Quicker one, around off, Richa Ghosh backs away and cuts it straight towards cover-point.
WIDE! Quicker one, trying to attack the pads but it is spilled down the leg side. Wided.
This is going down the leg side, Richa Ghosh gets a slight tickle on it. The fielder from short fine leg chases it down and keeps it down to a couple.
FOUR! Deft touch from Ghosh. Well played! Short and on off, Ghosh camps back and cuts late to beat short third man. A boundary results.
Darted into middle and leg, Ghosh defends it back towards the bowler.
Ecclestone bowls this one quicker and slides it onto the pads. Richa Ghosh looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is half an appeal for lbw but it is turned down.
Change. Sophie Ecclestone comes back into the attack for her second over. She has bowled a maiden already.
Slower length ball around leg, Ghosh tucks it behind square leg for one. At the halfway mark, India Women are 64 for 3.

Fine stop by Dunkley. Too full in length and outside off, Richa slices it through cover-point and the ball races away. Sophia Dunkley runs across to her left, puts in a slide near the fence and pulls it back. The third umpire is referred and the replays show that it's very close. Eventually, the decision is made and it's a couple.
Slower one, short and wide outside off, Kaur tries to cut but gets a bottom edge. It rolls wide of short third man and they pinch a single.
Pitches it up and around off, Kaur drives again but picks out mid off once more.
Fuller and on off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short in length and down the leg side, Harmanpreet Kaur just guides it via a pull shot to fine leg for a boundary.
Amy Jones is ringing in the changes. Takes off Sophie Ecclestone and brings Freya Kemp back into the attack.
Advances down the track to a full ball and knocks it down to long on for one.
A touch short and outside off, staying low, Ghosh cuts it to deep cover for one.
Around off, pushed to point.
Richa Ghosh is the new batter.

OUT! PLUMB LBW! Sarah Glenn has two. She pulls her length back a bit and delivers it around middle. Dayalan Hemalatha steps back to pull but misses and is hit on the back leg, right in front of the stumps. They appeal and the finger is raised immediately. Dayalan Hemalatha tries to have a word with her skipper but eventually, the time runs out for the DRS. India Women are in trouble now.
Edgy! Short again, close to off, Dayalan Hemalatha goes back to cut but edges it down to third man. The outfield is heavy and hence it's only two runs.
Shortish and on off, dragged down to long on for one.
Wide! Down the leg side, Kaur tries to flick but misses.
Maiden! Full and around off, Dayala sweeps but finds square leg. Tidy start from Sophie.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batter has just watchfully blocked this out.
Quicker and on middle, defended back.
Shout for an lbw! Not given. This one is skidding in from around middle and leg, Dayalan Hemalatha fails to work it around. She is hit on the pads, they appeal but the umpire is unmoved.

The batter there is distracted as the towel falls off from Sophie Ecclestone's pocket.​ It appears that Dayalan Hemalatha tries to pull out but then defends the ball in line of the stumps. Given as a legal ball and Dayalan smiles.
Change in bowling. Here comes Sophie Ecclestone.
FOUR! Timing! Tossed up, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur dances down the track and crunches it through the gap at extra cover for a lovely boundary.
Flatter and shorter on off, Kaur stays back and cuts it to point.
Harmanpreet Kaur is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! The dropped catch and the missed run out have not cost England Women much. Loopy and full around off, Shafali Verma gives the charge and tries to power it down the ground. Doesn't get enough power behind the shot and it's a simple catch for Bryony Smith at long off. A big blow to India Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Bryony Smith b Sarah Glenn

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker and fuller on middle, eased to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Up and over the infield. Full and flighted on middle, it's lofted over mid on for a boundary.

Sarah Glenn comes into the attack and nearly gets a wicket, via a run out. Verma helps it on the leg side and sets off for an impossible run. She gives up but survives as Glenn fails to knock down the stumps at the bowler's end.

Sawdust act as England's 12th player. Angling in, fuller in length around off, Verma drives it down the ground and the ball stops after hitting the sawdust kept near the bowler's run-up. Only one run. 41 for 1 after the Powerplay.
On a length around middle, Dayalana works it through square leg for one.
Wide! Another great take by Amy Jones. Poor line from the bowler, way down the leg side, the batter swings her bat and misses. Jonesy dives across to her left to collect the ball.

PUT DOWN! A massive reprieve for Shafali Verma. Fuller in length and outsidShafali Verma drives it uppishly towards extra cover where Sophia Dunkley puts down a simple catch. The batters pinch a single.
On a length and outside off, played down from the crease to backward point.

What a take from the keeper, Amy Jones! Drifting down the leg side, on a length, Shafali tries to flick but misses. Amy Jones shows quick hands as she collects the ball to her left. Captaincy has not affected her wicket-keeping skills.
A gentle delivery, full and on middle, Dayalan Hemalatha clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Freya Davies is back on. 0 for 7 in her 1 over so far.
FOUR! Thumped! Back of a length and around off, Shafali Verma hangs deep in her crease and muscles it back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On a length, angling across Verma who just plays it away towards cover-point.
Short of a length and around middle, Hemalatha pulls it away through mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Pitched up this time, on leg stump and this is worked away onto the leg side.
Good length, around off and angling across the right-hander. Dayalan Hemalatha gets beaten as she tries to play it off the back foot.
Kemp starts off with a length ball on the pads, Shafali Verma tucks it away through square leg and picks up a single.
Will Harmanpreet Kaur bat at number 3? Nopes. Dayalan Hemalatha is the new batter. There is a change in bowling as well. Freya Kemp to have a go now...

OUT! LBW! Bryony Smith has her wicket and Smriti Mandhana has to walk back! Smith floats it up on a length and around off. The angle of the ball is such that the ball is coming into the left-hander. Mandhana gets a big stride out as she looks to sweep it away but she misses. The ball hits her on the thigh pad and there is yet another appeal. This time the finger does go up and it is reviewed by Mandhana. Everything is fine with UltraEdge and Ball Tracking confirms the impact is with the umpire's call and the ball is going on to hit the stumps. The original decision stands!

DRS time. This time the finger has gone up after the lbw appeal against Smriti Mandhana. The batter has reviewed the decision. The impact could be an issue. Let's see... The impact is with the umpire's call and Ball Tracking shows that it's hitting the stumps. Big wicket for Bryony Smith and for England Women.

SHOUT FOR AN LBW! Not given. This is flatter and sliding onto the pads, Mandhana looks to work it away but misses. The ball hits her on the pads and there is a huge appeal for an LBW but the umpire remains unmoved. The bowler and the captain have a chat and they do decide to take the review at the very last moment. The third umpire is called in and finds no spike on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is sliding well down the leg side and the original decision of Not Out remains.
FOUR! Just too shirt and down the leg side as well. Mandhana has all the time in the world to rock back and pull it away past square leg for a boundary.
Unlucky! Full and down the leg side, Smriti Mandhana sweeps it well but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Full and outside off, curving away from the right-hander. Shafali Verma has a go at it but she ends up slicing it over extra cover. The ball plugs in the outfield and the batters get a run.
This is on the shorter side and sliding onto the pads, Smriti Mandhana tucks it away towards mid-wicket and scampers through for one.
Change in bowling. Bryony Smith is ready to bowl her off spinning deliveries. She bowled a lot for Trent Rockets Women in the Powerplay recently in The Women Hundred.
FOUR! A third boundary in the over and India Women are off to a flier. In the slot around off stump, Shafali Verma stays back and frees her arms as she thumps it over mid on for a boundary.
This is very full and around middle, Mandhana drives it firmly towards wide mid on and picks up a quick single.
FOUR! Just a fraction short from Bell, around off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and pulls it well in front of mid-wicket to pick up yet another boundary.
Length again, slanting across the left-hander. Smriti Mandhana looks to just run it past short third man but misses and it's a sharp take by Amy Jones behind the sticks.
Slip moves out. There is some extra protection on the leg side now as there is a mid-wicket in place inside the ring.
Just drags back the length a touch and bowls it around leg stump, Mandhana pushes it towards mid on.
FOUR! Easily done! Overpitched by Lauren Bell, Mandhana walks towards the ball and powers it over mid off for a boundary.
Full and straight, Verma flicks it straight towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length, around off, Smriti Mandhana pulls it well and towards wide mid on. Maia Bouchier makes a good stop there but can't prevent the single.
On middle and leg, Mandhana steps out again and flicks it away in front of square on the leg side for yet another brace.
Firmly struck but it is well stopped. Fullish length, outside off, Mandhan gives the charge and hits it towards the diving fielder at cover. Alice Capsey makes a good stop on this occasion.

Nicely timed but the outfield is quite damp. Length ball, outside off, Smriti Mandhana stands tall and drives it through the cover region. There is some misfield inside the ring. Sophia Dunkley from extra cover chases it down and keeps the batters down to a couple.
Good length, around the top of off. Shafali Verma opens the face of the bat and guides it towards backward point for a single. Verma is off the mark right away!
WIDE! Freya Davies starts off with a bit of a loosener. This is full and angling down leg, a wide is called.
Freya Davies to bowl from the other end.
A dot to end the opening over, just the boundary off it. On a fullish length and around off, shaping away. Mandhana looks to drive at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Lauren Bell pulls back the length and bowls it around off, Mandhana lets it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Up and over! India Women and Smriti Mandhana are off the mark in style. Pitched up, around off, Mandhana has to reach for it a bit but manages to get enough power on it. The ball goes over mid off and travels to the fence.
There's that movement. Bell goes fuller and bowls it outside off, Smriti Mandhana looks to give the charge but is undone by the movement away from her.
Much better on the second try, good length, outside off, Mandhana dabs it down towards the point region.
Bell slips while delivering her first delivery as the surface is a bit greasy. This is slower and shorter, pushed well outside off. Smriti Mandhana reaches out and taps it towards covers.

Right then, all in readiness here. It's a damp evening here in Chester-le-Street but we are lucky to have a full game. The England Women team is done with the customary huddle and now they are spreading on the field. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the openers for India Women.

It's a big moment for Kiran Navgire. She hails from Maharashtra's Solapur and shot to fame after her 76-ball 162 in a Twenty20 game against Arunachal Pradesh. She's the first Indian man or woman to score 150-plus runs in an innings in this format. Let's see how she fares in her debut game.
Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women, says they wanted to bowl but are prepared for both. Informs that Kiran Navgire is making her international debut.

England Women skipper, Amy Jones says that they are bowling with the rain around. Feels that there will be something in it for the bowlers early on. Adds that they are excited to have a young team and informs that Lauren Bell will be making her debut. On leading the team, Amy replies that it's a proud moment for her and her family.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Dayalan Hemalatha, Richa Ghosh (WK), Kiran Navgire (On debut), Pooja Vastrakar, Deepti Sharma, Sneh Rana, Radha Yadav and Renuka Singh.

England Women (Playing XI) - Danni Wyatt, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey, Amy Jones (C/WK), Maia Bouchier, Bryony Smith, Sophie Ecclestone, Freya Kemp, Sarah Glenn, Freya Davies and Lauren Bell (On T20I debut).
TOSS - Amy Jones flips the coin and Harmanpreet Kaur calls it wrongly. England Women have decided to BOWL first.
